name: Saijou Kiiko
source:
Sharp tongued and demanding, Kiiko is often seen as stuck up and selfish. This is because she is a perfectionist, and settles for nothing less than the best. Kiiko has no qualms to point out failures and deficiencies, and while she complains endlessly to the protagonist, its because she wants success. Kiiko specializes at creating parodies of established works.

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20070211064835/www.elizar.com/?p=7]Nargrakhan's review[/url]]
